questions.source: BPSC Senior Secondary Hindi - Advt. 24/2023 | कृष्णभक्ति शाखा - अष्टछाप
questions.en: Who among the following is the founder of 'Ashtachhap'?
questions.hi: इनमें से कौन 'अष्टछाप' के संस्थापक हैं?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Goswami Vitthalnath established Ashtachhap in 1565 AD by combining 4 disciples of his father Vallabhacharya (Kumbhandas, Surdas, Parmanandadas, Krishnadas) and 4 of his own disciples (Govindaswami, Chhitswami, Chaturbhujdas, Nanddas).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC Senior Secondary Hindi - Advt. 24/2023 | आंचलिक उपन्यास - रेणु
questions.en: Which of the following is a regional novel written by Phanishwar Nath 'Renu'?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा फणीश्वर नाथ 'रेणु' विरचित आंचलिक उपन्यास है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.answer_text: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'Maila Aanchal' (1954 AD - story of Meriganj village of Purnia) and 'Parti Parikatha' (1957 AD - Paranpur village) both are famous regional novels of Phanishwar Nath Renu. 'Titli' is a novel by Jaishankar Prasad.

questions.en: What is a forgiving, serious, stable, self-respecting and determined hero called in Indian poetics?
questions.hi: भारतीय काव्यशास्त्र में क्षमाशील, गम्भीर, स्थिरचित्त, स्वाभिमानी एवं दृढ़-प्रतिज्ञ नायक को क्या कहा गया है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: There are four main types of heroes in poetics: 1. Dhirodatta (serious, forgiving, self-respecting like Ram), 2. Dhirodat (arrogant, angry like Ravana/Bhim), 3. Dhirlalit (art lover, happy like Udayan), 4. Dhirprashant (calm, Brahmin/Vaishya like Charudatta).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.en: Which of the following Lakshana is also called 'Ajahatsvartha Lakshana'?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस लक्षणा को 'अजहत्स्वार्था लक्षणा' भी कहते हैं?

questions.source: BPSC Middle School Hindi-English - Advt. 22/2023 | अलंकार - उत्प्रेक्षा
questions.en: “Sohat odhe yellow patu, shyaam saalune gaat. Manhu neelmani-sail par atpu paryo morning.” Which figure of speech has been used in the said couplet?
questions.hi: “सोहत ओढ़े पीत पटु, श्याम सलौने गात। मनहु नीलमनि-सैल पर आतपु परयो प्रभात॥” उक्त दोहे में किस अलंकार का प्रयोग हुआ है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: In this couplet written by Biharilal, the darkness on the dark body of Shri Krishna has been compared to the possibility of morning sunshine on the sapphire mountain. The meaning word 'Manhu' is the identity of Utpreksha.
